explanation: Andrés Iniesta scored the only goal of the final against the Netherlands, in extra time in Johannesburg. It was Spain's first World Cup title.

claims.text: Spain won the 2010 men's World Cup in South Africa, the first World Cup held in Africa.
The Netherlands lost the 2010 final, and Germany and Brazil were knocked out before it.
Andrés Iniesta scored the only goal of the 2010 final, in extra time at Soccer City in Johannesburg.
The 2010 World Cup was Spain's first.
